title: Frame times
description:
Keep the last 120 frame times and show the numbers a performance overlay needs.

```
last 120 frames: average 16.7 ms (60 fps), worst 33.4 ms, best 15.9 ms
frames over 20 ms: 3
```
hints: Once the ring is full, the oldest value is the one about to be overwritten, at `m_next`; before that it is at 0. Reading `m_values[(offset + i) % 120]` for `i` from 0 to `m_count - 1` visits them oldest first.
requirements: A fixed ring of 120 floats, written in a circle.
Average, minimum and maximum over the frames recorded so far (fewer than 120 at the start).
A way to read the values in order from oldest to newest: the index of the oldest value (the **offset**) and the count. Graph widgets you meet later (lesson 5.01) take the ring in exactly this form.
stretch: Show a smoothed fps that changes slowly instead of every frame.
